church.name: Foundation of Truth Assembly
church.vision: To build a house full of excellence truth and love.
church.location: 40/42 IMAM DAUDA ST. OFF ERIC MOORE RD. SURULERE LAGOS

events.title: Sunday Worship Service
events.description: Join us for worship, teaching, and community.

events.title: Wisdom Word Service (Mid-Week)
events.description: A time to learn and ask questions as we study the Word. Join in person or online via YouTube @FOTA TV.

events.title: Free Medical Outreach
events.description: Free medical check-ups, prescriptions, and medical attention at our church clinic. Open to everyone. Support by contributing financially or volunteering as medical personnel.

events.title: Child Dedication Service
events.description: We dedicate children to the Lord. Fill out the FOTA Child Dedication form on our mobile app to register.

events.title: The Art of Love - Couples Event
events.description: FOTA Family Life invites couples (newlyweds or longtime partners) to reconnect, laugh, and grow stronger together.
events.location: Ogudu GRA, Gate D, by Domino's Pizza, Ramat Bus Stop

policies.title: Tithing
policies.summary: Tithing is taught as an act of love toward God and not as a law. Speak to church leaders to receive a tithe number or give using the description 'TITHE'.

policies.title: Child Dedication
policies.summary: Child Dedication takes place on the last Sunday of every month. Complete the FOTA Child Dedication form in the mobile app.

policies.title: Free Medical Outreach
policies.summary: Held every Friday at 10:00 AM in the church clinic. Open to everyone and supported by volunteers and financial donations.

faqs.question: What are the service times?
faqs.answer: Sunday Worship is at 8:00 AM and 10:30 AM, and Wisdom Word Service meets every Wednesday at 6:30 PM.

faqs.question: Where is the church located?
faqs.answer: Foundation of Truth Assembly is at 40/42 IMAM DAUDA ST. OFF ERIC MOORE RD. SURULERE LAGOS.

faqs.question: How can I contact the church office?
How do I register for child dedication?
faqs.answer: Complete the FOTA Child Dedication form in the mobile app and our Ceremonies Pastor will respond promptly.
